name: Beatitudes
overview: The Beatitudes, as presented in Matthew 5, reveal the character and blessings of those who belong to the kingdom of heaven. Jesus teaches that the poor in spirit, those who mourn, the meek, and those who hunger and thirst for righteousness are blessed, receiving comfort, inheritance, and fulfillment. These verses emphasize a Christ-centered humility and dependence on God that leads to spiritual blessing and eternal reward.
